name: Stock Price Prediction (AI4ALL)
description: A financial NLP pipeline predicting stock movement from headlines and market data.
longDescription: Built an end-to-end financial NLP pipeline processing 322K headlines and 20M stock records, using FinBERT sentiment analysis for stock-movement classification. Engineered a novel Competitive Pressure Index capturing negative-news surges relative to each stock's baseline coverage, used as the core feature for downstream classification. Trained a Random Forest classifier via 5-fold cross-validation, achieving 54% accuracy and outperforming a Logistic Regression baseline.

name: CITIES Dashboard
description: An interactive air quality dashboard for schools across Monroe, Louisiana.
longDescription: Built the front-end of a dashboard delivering air-quality insights to 20K+ students across Monroe, Louisiana schools. Automated deployment with GitHub Actions, replacing manual build-and-release steps with a single pipeline and cutting release time by roughly 30%.
